title: Add auto-title generation to chat endpoint after first messages
description:
Modify chatbot/api/chat.py to automatically generate conversation titles using the LLM after the first messages are received. Before editing, inspect: current chat endpoint implementation and conversation ID handling.

1. Add hook after initial message(s)
2. Use LLM to generate short title (2-5 words) from messages
3. Update conversation title in storage
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/api/chat.py generates conversation titles after first messages
Title generation does not block main chat response
